ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - Radmin Viewer Utility Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of Radmin which can be abused by an adversary to remotely control Windows machines

sequences.query: (process_description = "Radmin\ Viewer" OR process_product = "Radmin\ Viewer" OR process_original_file_name = "Radmin\.exe")
